title: Phase 8 PR-3: official CBIC rules, a real rate conflict, and posting still off
head: 94d21b6
local_verification: 2689 passed, 5 xfailed. bandit at LOW clean. ruff clean. pyright 0 errors. .github diff empty on this branch.

codeant_findings.claim: The runner never compares total_including_tax_paise with the committed expectation, though the case builder records it.
codeant_findings.evidence: grep for total_including_tax_paise returned the builder, the 60-case pack and the calculator, and nothing in the scorer.
codeant_findings.fix: Comparison added, GATED ON THE OUTCOME rather than read straight off decision.computation as the comment suggested.
codeant_findings.why_not_the_literal_suggestion: The arithmetic runs before the ledger check, so a refusing decision still carries a computed total. gt-rules-badrule-09 (a company with no IGST ledger) has computation.total_including_tax_paise == 128000 while the pack correctly expects None. Following the suggestion verbatim turned that case red. Gating on TaxOutcome.VALID mirrors what TaxDecision.total_tax_paise already does.
codeant_findings.mutation: Making the total drop the tax turns 40 of 40 valid cases red. Before the fix that mutant survived every one of them.

second_defect_fixed_in_this_pr.found_by: the pr-fast gate, not by review
second_defect_fixed_in_this_pr.claim: bandit B101: assert used. The line carried '# noqa: S101', which is ruff's code and suppresses nothing in bandit.
second_defect_fixed_in_this_pr.fix: Replaced with a runtime fail-closed refusal rather than a '# nosec'. python -O strips asserts, so under -O the None reached compute() and failed with a message naming the arithmetic instead of the corpus.
second_defect_fixed_in_this_pr.proof: Restoring the assert turns test_a_found_lookup_with_no_rule_attached_is_refused_at_runtime red with AssertionError at decision.py:192.

noted_not_fixed: python scripts/run_ground_truth.py with no arguments raises TypeError: 'PosixPath' object is not iterable at validate_ground_truth.py:423 - run_manifest passes a Path where argparse wants an argv list. Reproduced at the unmodified commit, so pre-existing. Out of scope, flagged rather than folded in.
